 by Bob Maplewood at 12:30am on Wed 4th November 2026   (last updated 4:31pm 07/11/2026 )
 Deportivo de A Coruna go up against Espanyol this coming Saturday for a LaLiga meeting at RCDE Stadium.
 Espanyol are placed 14th with 11 points after 11 matches. Deportivo de A Coruna occupy a position as eightth in the league on 14 points. 
 Espanyol need a good result here against Deportivo de A Coruna, if they wish to climb the LaLiga table. The guests have proven, they can be a dangerous opponent, but the former should be able to hold their on at the RCDE Stadium. 
 Espanyol go into their next LaLiga match, scoring a humble average of one per game in their last ten matches. They scored a mundane ten times, while conceding 14. That amounts to an average of 1.4 per game, where they kept their opponents from scoring two times. 
 Deportivo de A Coruna managed a bearable 14 goals from their past ten games, creating an average of 1.4 goals per game. They conceded 13 goals in total, and while claiming zero clean sheets, they conceded 1.3 goals an average per game. 
 Betting on the draw would have earned you a sound profit the last time Espanyol played Deportivo de A Coruna. The pair finished even in a 0-0 match, where no one managed to get the upper hand. 
 Espanyol vs Deportivo de A Coruna Prediction
 Espanyol Form
 Espanyol lost twice in their last three matches, as they were defeated 0-1 by Atletico Madrid and 2-1 against Racing Santander. They turned the table by winning 0-1 against Villarreal. Espanyol just have a single home win to show from their efforts in the past six LaLiga matches at the RCDE Stadium. They also drew two and lost three of these six encounters, in which they scored seven and conceded eight goals.
 They had their sights set on gold, but Espanyol could soon be forced to readjust the target to qualifying for Europe. 
 Deportivo de A Coruna Form 
 Deportivo de A Coruna claimed a single victory in their last three matches. They started with a 1-1 draw against Levante. Afterwards, a 1-0 defeat against Atletico Madrid followed, before beating Osasuna 2-1. Deportivo de A Coruna claimed just one win from the last six away games in the LaLiga. They also drew two and were defeated three times, as they were outscored by ten goals to eight. 
 Deportivo de A Coruna have already squandered enough points to put themselves under pressure, if they are to challenge for the title seriously in the LaLiga this season. 
 Espanyol and Deportivo de A Coruna are both scoring more or less for fun right now, and a very entertaining game should be on the menu. More often than not, their matches against each other turn out high scoring affairs. 
 Espanyol claimed three wins, two draws as well as six defeats in the LaLiga this season. Deportivo de A Coruna enjoy a record of three wins, five draws and three defeats in the LaLiga.
